goal: Fix canvas text auto-growth boundaries, make zoom range predictable, add center reset and colored tag markers to the minimap, and remove user-facing layer-order actions.
non_goals: Do not rewrite the React Flow canvas architecture.
Do not remove internal geometry, z-index or persistence fields unless they are unreachable after removing the menu actions.
Do not change database schema or user documents.
Do not add a second independent tag catalog; reuse the existing canvas image tag model where possible.
Do not change unrelated chat, recovery, provider or release behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Text nodes retain their drawn/manual height while content fits; automatic vertical growth starts only after measured content exceeds the current node height.
Growth is monotonic, bounded and guarded against non-finite or pathological measurements; repeated input cannot grow forever without additional overflow.
Canvas zoom clamps to a maximum of 100% and a minimum of 0.1%, with wheel/pinch and programmatic viewport updates using the same bounds.
The minimap exposes a clear center/reset action that animates the viewport to the current canvas content center without changing document data.
Tag categories/colors are projected onto minimap node markers at their actual canvas positions, with deterministic fallback for untagged nodes.
User-facing layer-order menu items and handlers are removed; ordinary node selection, deletion and context actions remain available.
Focused tests, full Canvas tests, TypeScript, production build and an independent read-only review pass.
do_not_touch: main branch history before this task
tracked tests outside the focused Canvas scope
notes: Use explicit UTF-8 for all Chinese source and report I/O.
Prefer pure policies and focused contract tests before touching the large React components.

The supplied recording shows a 600% start state, a narrow node becoming vertically unbounded, and a visible layer-order menu; treat those as reproduction evidence, not as exact implementation constraints.
